Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. Govt. Lko And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Alok Kumar Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. This is the second bail application.
The first bail application was rejected vide order dated 22.04.2022.
3. While arguing the second bail application, the counsel for the applicant argues that the FIR in question was lodged after about three days of the alleged incident.
He further argues that after the rejection of the first bail application, the trial has not proceeded and not even one witness has been examined.
The said fact is corroborated by Annexure No. 8.
Budun Alias Rohit Lal vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ...

entities.text: Budun Alias Rohit Lal vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the fact that the applicant is languishing in jail since 18.04.2021 and the prosecution is not proceeding and not even one witness has been examined, the applicant who has no criminal history deserves to be enlarged on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Budun Alias Rohit Lal be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 0105 of 2021,
under Sections 376, 506 IPC, Section 3(2)(V) SC/ST Act and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Bhadokhar, District Raebareli, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 14.8.2024 Arun  Budun Alias Rohit Lal vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61164770/
